ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle overdue). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 335.26. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle overdue
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 42 · daily cycle day 32).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): counter-trend bounce. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds

entry.text: Counter-trend bounce inside a bearish bigger picture. For nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 335.26. If the daily low fails it cascades toward the larger cycle low; not an investment buy.
entry.text_zh: 处于看空大局中的逆势反弹。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 335.26 下方。若日线低点失守，将向更大周期低点蔓延；并非投资性买入。

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early reversal building (heads-up): MACD histogram turned up off a trough (pre-cross). These anticipate a low BEFORE full confirmation — earlier entry, but a higher false-alarm rate, so treat as a heads-up to watch closely, not a trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 短期来看，正在形成日线筑底形态——但大局看空（weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle overdue）。此处的反弹属于逆势：与周线周期低点不对齐的日线周期低点往往呈左移结构并最终失败，随后向更大周期低点蔓延——这正是在下行的投资者周期中买入日线低点的陷阱。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 335.26 下方。并非投资性买入；在采信之前，请等待周线周期真正转向上行（或出现新的投资者周期低点予以确认）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为正；但正趋向周线向下交叉；3 日线向下交叉；投资者周期已逾期（投资者周期第 42 周 · 日线周期第 32 天）。

ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
